Resume Context

Resume Context workflow for coding agents. Use when work resumes after a break.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Recover verified state, unresolved items, and one next action from saved notes.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.
